item.text: {"hypothesis_status":"not_supported","summary":"L016 executed successfully and passed the fixed G01 positive-Tc guard (8.5861 K <= 8.8322 K), but it was not an eligible improvement. Its pooled weighted training OOF MAE was 8.2679 K, which is 0.5153 K worse than A05's 7.7526 K and well above the required improvement threshold of 7.7426 K. Relative to L015, replacing the cluster1 extra_trees/raw expert with hist_gradient_boosting/raw improved positive-Tc MAE from 8.8559 K to 8.5861 K and high-Tc MAE from 30.7888 K to 29.7893 K, but worsened reported-zero MAE from 6.7567 K to 7.5609 K and pooled MAE from 8.2044 K to 8.2679 K. Cluster1 retained severe opposing errors, including reported-zero predictions near 70–72 K and 87.8–95 K materials predicted near 0.6–13.6 K. Estimator smoothing therefore shifted the subgroup tradeoff enough to restore guard eligibility but did not rescue cluster1 specialization.","next_action":"continue","next_focus":"The required minimum remains pending, with 16 of 22 successful unique cycles completed. Test the untried cluster0 estimator-only analogue: composition input, kmeans3 routing, global extra_trees/raw, and only a cluster0 hist_gradient_boosting/raw expert, leaving cluster1 and cluster2 on global fallback. L014's cluster0 extra_trees/raw expert narrowly failed the positive-Tc guard while slightly improving reported-zero MAE relative to G01; L016 shows that hist_gradient_boosting/raw can improve positive- and high-Tc errors for a kmeans route, although at a substantial zero-Tc cost. This experiment isolates whether that estimator tradeoff is more favorable in cluster0. It is falsified as an eligible improvement unless pooled weighted OOF MAE is below 7.742598770753422 K and positive-Tc MAE remains at or below 8.832165507919859 K.","stop_reason":"","limitations":["All measurements are adaptive development evidence from reused fixed-group training OOF folds, not independent validation or proof of generalization.","L016 passed the positive-Tc guard but missed the incumbent by 0.5153 K, so it is not an eligible win.","The aggregate positive- and high-Tc improvements came with a substantial deterioration on reported-zero rows.","KMeans cluster identities may shift between folds, and these partitions are operational composition rules rather than verified physical families.","The counterexamples are historically observed materials and do not identify new superconductors."]}
